spans.text:
Alice opens the observatory.
She calibrates the telescope. The first image shows Saturn.

Bob surveys the wetland. He records three herons.
spans.title: Field observations
spans.summary: The team records Saturn and wetland birds.

Carol repairs the radio. A loose cable caused the fault. The signal returns.
The team files its report. It includes the observing schedule.
spans.title: Repair and reporting
spans.summary: The radio signal returns, and the team files a report with its schedule.
